snippet.title: Fear The Unknown - Dave Story | New Atmospheric UFO Horror Game
snippet.description:
Fear The Unknown - Dave Story | Atmospheric UFO Horror Game
#newgame #gameplay #gaming #indiegame #atmospheric #retrogaming 

Buy Game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328450/Fear_The_Unknown__Dave_Story/

Fear the unknown ,In the game, you will play as one of the lucky ones who met them and survived.

Fear The Unknown : Dave Story
This episode tells the story of an ordinary working-class guy who was sent to work in a remote location, deep and far from civilization. He was incredibly lucky—his story reached us. Pay attention to the small details, as they may help you survive. This is just the beginning.

The Gameplay
This game offers a first-person narrative experience, blending walking simulation with elements of exploration, driving, drinking, and interactive conversations. It is a short game about UFOs, with approximately 30 minutes of gameplay.

Game Control
ASDW - Movements

[LMB] - Action

[RMB] - Task help , Drink

Comments from the developer
Although we may sometimes appear similar to one another, each of us possesses unique qualities and new values.
